words.example: Find someone who can translate the consent page while the family waits.
words.exampleZh: 请找人在家属等候时把同意书翻译出来。

words.example: Explain the privacy sheet slowly, using simple words the family knows.
words.exampleZh: 请用家属听得懂的简单词语，慢慢解释这份隐私说明。

words.example: Describe how the chairs should be set so facilities can copy that layout.
words.exampleZh: 请描述椅子该怎么摆，方便总务照着布置。

words.example: Define, in one sentence, who may approve a door pass on the same day.
words.exampleZh: 请用一句话界定谁可以在当天批准门禁证。

words.example: The updated duty list must specify the date it starts.
words.exampleZh: 更新后的值班名单必须明确开始日期。

words.example: The CNAME (Canonical Name) for mail follows the new records server name.
words.exampleZh: 邮件的 CNAME（别名记录）跟着新病历服务器的名称走。

words.example: Change the A record so the portal name points at the new web host.
words.exampleZh: 改掉地址记录，让门户名称指向新的网站主机。

words.example: The MX record must point at the hospital mail gateway, not the old relay.
words.exampleZh: 邮件交换记录必须指向医院邮件网关，不能指向旧中继。

words.example: Lower the TTL (Time To Live) before we rename the lab server tonight.
words.exampleZh: 今晚给检验服务器改名之前，先把 TTL（生存时间）调低。

words.example: The DHCP reservation keeps this anesthesia PC on the same address.
words.exampleZh: 这条地址保留让这台麻醉电脑一直用同一个地址。
